Clear your calendars and set your alarms! ⏰ Friends, I’m delighted to announce that registration for Well Crafted Sonoma 2026—a creative retreat in the heart of California wine country—opens this Sunday, November 30, 2025 at 9 a.m. PT.  
  
The retreat page is now LIVE, so feel free to explore all the details: workshops, lodging, dining, itinerary, pricing, and more. 👉 robert-mahar.com/sonoma [...] 🥁 And now, drumroll please… our guest instructor for 2026 is the terrifically talented @mimikirchner! 🎉 I feel so fortunate that Mimi has been both a colleague and friend for more than two decades, and we’re excited to guide you through a series of inspiring projects rooted in needlework and textile craft. results.content:
Registration is now open for Continuing the Not So Big Life Journey, a three-day online workshop, taking place July 17 - 19, 2026 [...] This gathering is for those who have already explored the foundations of Not So Big Living through previous Not So Big Life events and feel moved to go deeper in their exploration, practice, and inquiry. (If you've never attended a Not So Big Life event, the next introductory workshop will take place September 3 - 5, 2026. See the link in my profile for more information.)   
  
Register now or read more in my latest newsletter (link in profile). [...] For these workshops, we gather on Zoom, but not as a meeting—as a retreat. Space is intentionally limited to 25 participants so that there is time for each person to engage in the inquiry, share personal reflections, and participate meaningfully within the group.  
  
Register now to save your spot (link in profile).  
  
I hope to see you in July.  
  
#notsobiglife #notsobiglifeworkshop #continuingthejourney #summerretreat
